description: Update the workshop/initialization skills (the skills that drive agents producing workshop round JSON) to consult the ui-mockup-generation skill and invoke the image CLI helper per-option when: (a) EnableImageGeneration setting is true AND (b) the 'would seeing this change the user's answer?' gate fires. The gate logic lives in the ui-mockup-generation skill; this item wires the invocation into the actual workshop flow. Automated test using a recorded fixture: workshop skill produces round JSON with image_url populated exactly on the gated options, and no images when the toggle is off.
name: workshop-skill-image-guidance
title: Integrate ui-mockup-generation gate into workshop-driving skills
